extracted.intended_audience: Prospective NIMH research trainees and applicants preparing training/career development grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Overview guidance for individuals seeking NIMH research training and career development support, including how to identify appropriate mechanisms by career stage and procedural steps before preparing applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact NIMH training representative before preparing an application
rubrics_metrics.description: Please contact the NIMH Research Training and Career Development representative in the appropriate Division before preparing an application. Get Contact Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement: applicants should reach out to the designated NIMH contact for their division to discuss fit, eligibility, and program-specific expectations prior to application preparation. The page emphasizes obtaining contact information via the provided link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware NIH is revising application and review criteria for certain mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note: NIH is revising the application and review criteria for the following applications. NIH Fellowship applications. NIH Institutional Training Grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must check for and follow the updated application and review criteria for fellowship and institutional training grant (e.g., T32) mechanisms; do not rely solely on older guidance. Confirm current instructions before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select opportunity appropriate to career stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Search opportunities by career stage: Predoctoral, Postdoctoral, Early career, Mid-career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match your career stage to the correct funding mechanism and program announcements. The page groups opportunities by career stage to help applicants find suitable fellowships, career development awards, or institutional programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose appropriate program type/mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Search opportunities by program type: Individual Fellowships, Career Development Awards, Physician-Scientists and Other Clinician-Scientists, Institutional Programs (T32, R25), NIH Loan Repayment Program, Other research training opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the funding mechanism that fits your role and goals (e.g., individual fellowship vs institutional T32). Consider clinician-scientist specific mechanisms and loan repayment programs where applicable; follow mechanism-specific instructions and eligibility requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider intramural research opportunities at NIMH
rubrics_metrics.description: For research training opportunities on the NIMH campus in Bethesda, see Research Conducted at NIMH (Intramural Research Program).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should also evaluate intramural training options at NIMH as an alternative to extramural mechanisms; follow the intramural program's separate procedures and contacts.
